ما للجِمَالِ مَشْيِها وئيداً * أجندلاً يحملن أَم حديدَا
(What is with the camels, their walking so slowly? Is it stones they carry, or iron?)

He meant: what is with the camels, what is with their walking slowly? Another said:

ذرِينى إن أمركِ لن يطاعَا * وما ألفيتنِى حِلِمى مُضَاعَا
(Leave me: your command will not be obeyed; and you have not found me — my forbearance — lost.)

"Forbearance" is accusative by "finding", by way of repetition [i.e. as badal (substitute)]; had you made it nominative it would be correct.
And He said: ﴿فِي يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍ﴾ ("on a stormy day"), making "stormy" follow "day" in its i'rab, whereas the storming belongs to the wind. That is permissible in two ways. One of them is that storming, even though it belongs to the wind, may be used to describe the day because the wind is in it; so it is permissible to say "a stormy day" just as you say "a cold day" and "a hot day". One of them recited to me:

* يومين غيمين ويوماً شمساً *
(Two cloudy days and a sunny day.)

He described the two days as "cloudy", whereas the clouds are only in them. The other way is that He means "on a day stormy of wind", and "the wind" is omitted because it has already been mentioned at the beginning of the expression, as the poet said:

فيضحكُ عرفانَ الدروع جلودُنا * إذا جاء يوم مظلمُ الشمس كاسفُ
(Our skins laugh in recognition of the coats of mail when a day comes dark of sun, eclipsed.)

He meant "eclipsed of sun". These are two ways. [A third:] if you intend to make (عاصف) an attribute of the wind specifically, then since it came after "day" you make it follow the i'rab of "day"; it is of the speech of the Arabs that they make a genitive follow a genitive when it resembles it.
The poet said:

كأَنَّما ضربت قدّام أعينِها * قُطْنا بمستحصِد الأوتار محلوج
(As though she [the cloud] had beaten before their eyes cotton carded by a taut-stringed bow.)

And another said:

تريك سُنَّة وجه غيرِ مُقرفَةٍ * مَلْسَاء ليس بها خال وَلاَ نَدَبُ
(She shows you the contour of a face not base-born, smooth, with neither mole nor scar on it.)

He said: I heard al-Farrāʾ say: I said to Abū Tharwān, when he had recited this verse to me with the genitive: How do you say "turīka sunnata wajhin ghayra muqrifatin"? He said: "turīka sunnata wajhin ghayra muqrifatin." I said to him: Then recite — and he put ghayr in the genitive. I repeated the question to him, and he said: "What you say is better than what I say", yet his recitation was with the genitive. And another said:

وإيَّاكم وحَيَّة بطنِ وادٍ * هَمُوزِ الناب ليسَ لكم بِسِىّ
(Beware of a snake of a valley's floor, with a biting fang — it is no match for you.)

Among what our early grammarians relate is that the Arabs say: "hādhā juḥru ḍabbin kharibin" ("this is a lizard's hole, ruined" — with "ruined" in the genitive). The proper way is to say: sunnata wajhin ghayra muqrifatin [Translator's note: the text has «مقرقة» here, evidently for «مقرفة»], ḥayyata baṭni wādin hamūza al-nāb, and «هذا جُحْرٍ ضبّ خرِبٌ» [Translator's note: so in the text; the intended form is evidently juḥru ḍabbin kharibun, with "hole" and "ruined" nominative]. It is reported of Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb that he read ﴿إِنَّ اللهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو القُوَّة المَتِينِ﴾ ("Allah is the Provider, the Possessor of strength, the Firm"), putting al-matīn in the genitive, and al-Aʿmash adopted it. The proper way is to make (المتين) nominative. Abū al-Jarrāḥ al-ʿUqaylī recited to me:

يا صاحِ بَلِّغ ذَوِى الزوجَات كُلِّهم * أن ليس وصلٌ إذا انحلّت عُرَا الذَنْب
(O friend, tell all those who have wives that there is no union once the knots of the tail are undone.)

He made (كلّ) follow the genitive of (الزوجات), whereas it is accusative, because it is a naʿt (adjective) of ذوى.

farraa:22-22.t:
His saying: ﴿مَّآ أَنَاْ بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ بِمُصْرِخِيَّ﴾ ("I cannot be your rescuer, nor can you be my rescuers"): that is, the yāʾ has fatḥa, because the yāʾ of the speaker is made quiescent when what precedes it is vowelled, and it takes fatḥa with the intention of the hāʾ [Translator's note: so in the text: «إرادة الهاء»; the sense is presumably the hāʾ of pause (hāʾ al-sakt), as in «لِيَه»], as was read: ﴿لكم دينكم ولىَ دين﴾ ("to you your religion and to me mine") and (ولِى دين) — so it was given fatḥa and made quiescent. When what precedes it is quiescent, it is returned to the fatḥa it originally had. The yāʾ of (مُصْرِخِىّ) is quiescent and the speaker's yāʾ after it is quiescent, so it was given a vowel it originally had. This is regular in speech.
Similar to it is ﴿يَا بَنِىَّ إِنَّ اللّهْ﴾, and ﴿فَمَنْ تَبِعَ هُدَاىَ﴾, and ﴿مَحْيَاىَ وممَاتى﴾.
Al-Aʿmash and Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb both read the yāʾ of His saying ﴿بِمُصْرِخِيَّ﴾ with kasra. Al-Qāsim ibn Maʿn narrated to me from al-Aʿmash, from Yaḥyā, that he gave the yāʾ kasra. Al-Farrāʾ said: perhaps it is one of the slips of the readers of Yaḥyā's generation, for few of them were safe from slips. Perhaps he thought that the bāʾ in (بمصرخىّ) puts the whole word in the genitive, and that the speaker's yāʾ is outside that. Among what we consider they slipped in is His saying ﴿نُوَلِّهِ مَا تَوَلَّى ونُصْلِهِ جَهَنَّمَ﴾ ("We shall turn him to what he has turned to, and burn him in Hell"): they thought — and Allah knows best — that the jussive is on the hāʾ, whereas the hāʾ is in the position of the accusative, and the verb before it has already become jussive by the dropping of the yāʾ from it.
And among what they slipped in is His saying ﴿وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ الشيَاطِينُ﴾ ("and the devils have not brought it down") [Translator's note: the slip referred to is the reading al-shayāṭūn]. Mandal ibn ʿAlī al-ʿAnazī narrated from al-Aʿmash, who said: I was with Ibrāhīm al-Nakhaʿī, and Ṭalḥa ibn Muṣarrif [was reciting] ﴿قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُ أَلاَ تَسْتَمِعْونَ﴾ ("he said to those around him: do you not hear?") with fatḥa on the lām of (حوله). Ibrāhīm said: You keep bringing us a more outrageous letter! It is only ﴿لِمَنْ حَوْلِه﴾. He said: I said: No, it is only (حَولَه). He said: Ibrāhīm said: O Ṭalḥa, how do you say it? He said: As you said: (لمن حَوْلِهِ). Al-Aʿmash said: I said: You have both committed a solecism; I will not sit with you today. And I have heard one of the Arabs recite:

قال لها هل لك يا تافِيِّ * قالت له مَا أنتَ بالمرضِىّ
(He said to her: "Will you, O you who are in me…?" She said to him: "You are not one to be pleased with.")

He gave the yāʾ of (فىّ) kasra. If that is sound, it is of the kind where two quiescent letters meet and the second of them is given kasra, even though it originally has fatḥa. Do you not see that they say: "I have not seen him mudhu al-yawm" and "mudhi al-yawm"? The ḍamma on the dhāl is the proper way, because it is the original vowel of mudh, and the kasra is permissible. So likewise the yāʾ of muṣrikhiyy was given kasra although it originally has fatḥa.
His saying: ﴿إِنِّي كَفَرْتُ بِمَآ أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ﴾ ("I disbelieved in your associating me"): this is the saying of Iblīs. He said to them: I had disbelieved in what you associated me with, meaning with Allah, Mighty and Majestic, (مِنْ قَبْل) ("before"). He made (مَا) take the course of what stands for a noun. [ms. 89b]

farraa:26-26.t: His saying: ﴿وَمَثلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجْتُثَّتْ﴾ ("and the likeness of an evil word is like an evil tree, uprooted"). You make "likeness" nominative by the kāf in "tree". And had you made "likeness" accusative [it would be correct], meaning: "and Allah struck the likeness of an evil word". In the reading of Ubayy it is (وضرب مثلاً كلمة خبيثة) ("and He struck as a likeness an evil word") like an evil tree. All are correct.

farraa:27-27.t: His saying: ﴿يُثَبِّتُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ ٱلثَّابِتِ فِي ٱلْحَيَاةِ﴾ ("Allah makes firm those who believe with the firm word in the life [of this world]"). It is said: with "There is no god but Allah"; this is in this world. And when he is asked about it in the grave after his death, he says it if he is one of the people of felicity, and if he is one of the people of wretchedness he does not say it. That is His saying, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿وَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ﴾ ("and Allah leads astray the wrongdoers") from it, i.e. from saying "There is no god but Allah". ﴿وَيَفْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ﴾ ("and Allah does what He wills"), i.e. do not deny any power to Him; and He is not questioned about what He does.

farraa:29-29.t: His saying: ﴿جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا﴾ ("Hell, which they will enter to burn"): accusative as an explanation of (دَارَ البَوَارِ) ("the abode of ruin"), referred back to it. Had you made it nominative by resumption, when it is separated from the verse, it would be correct. The nominative then has two ways: one of them is as mubtadaʾ (subject); the other is to make it nominative by the pronoun returning to it, as He said: ﴿بِشرٍّ مِنْ ذَلِكُمُ النَّارُ وَعَدَهَا اللهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ ("of something worse than that: the Fire, which Allah has promised to those who disbelieve").

farraa:31-31.t: His saying: ﴿قُل لِّعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ يُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلاَةَ﴾ ("say to My servants who believe [that] they should establish the prayer"). (يُقِيمُوا) was made jussive on the interpretation of a conditional answer (jazāʾ), but its meaning — and Allah knows best — is that of a command; as you say: "Say to ʿAbdullāh [that] he should go away from us", meaning "go away from us". It was made jussive with the intention of an answer [i.e. apodosis] for the jussive, while its interpretation is the command; it was not made jussive by way of reported speech. Had its jussive been purely by reported speech, it would be permissible to say: "I told you, you go (tadhhab), O you!" It was only made jussive as was made jussive as was made jussive [Translator's note: the phrase is repeated so in the text] his saying "Leave him, he will sleep (yanam)", and ﴿فَذ‍َرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ﴾ ("so leave her to eat"), whose interpretation — and Allah knows best — is "leave her, and let her eat". Similar to it is ﴿قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَغْفِرُوا لِلَّذِينَ لاَ يَرْجُونَ﴾ ("say to those who believe that they should forgive those who do not hope…"), and similar to it is ﴿وَقُلْ لعِبَادِى يَقُولُوا الَّتىِ هِىَ أَحْسَنُ﴾ ("and say to My servants that they should say what is best").

farraa:34-34.t: His saying, Blessed and Exalted: ﴿وَآتَاكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ﴾ ("and He gave you of all that you asked of Him"): you annex (كلّ) to (مَا); this is the reading of the generality. Some read (وَآتَاكُم مِّن كُلٍّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ), as though they took the view that we did not ask Allah, Mighty and Majestic, for a sun, nor a moon, nor much of His bounty; so He said: "and He gave you of everything what you did not ask", so that (ما) is a negation. The first way is more pleasing to me, because the meaning — and Allah knows best — is: He gave you of all that you asked Him, had you asked Him; as though you said: "and He gave you all your request". Do you not see that you say to a man who has asked for nothing: "By Allah, I will give you your request", i.e. what your asking would reach, even though you did not ask?

farraa:35-35.t: His saying: ﴿وَٱجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ ٱلأَصْنَامَ﴾ ("and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols"). The people of the Ḥijāz say janabanī, light; and the people of Najd say: "ajnibnī his evil" and "jannibnī his evil". Had a reader read (وَأَجْنِبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ) he would be correct, but I have not heard it from any reader.

farraa:37-37.t:
His saying: ﴿إِنَّيۤ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي﴾ ("I have settled some of my offspring"). He said ﴿إِنَّيۤ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي﴾ and did not bring anything of them for the verb to fall upon. That is permissible: you may say "We struck some of Banū So-and-so" and "We killed some of Banū So-and-so" even if you do not say "men", because min stands for part of the people, as you say: "We had some of the food and drank some of the water". Similar to it is ﴿أَنْ أَفِيضُوا عَلَيْنَا مِنَ المَاءِ أَوْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللهُ﴾ ("pour on us some of the water or of what Allah has provided you").
His saying: ﴿تَهْوِيۤ إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ ("incline towards them"). He is saying: make hearts among people desire them; as you say: "I saw So-and-so heading (yahwī) towards you", i.e. wanting you. Some of the readers read (تَهْوَى إلَيْهِمْ) with fatḥa on the wāw, in the sense of "love them" (tahwāhum), as He said ﴿رَدِفَ لَكُمْ﴾, meaning "radifakum" ("close behind you"), and as they said: "I paid her a hundred (naqadtu lahā)", i.e. naqadtuhā.

farraa:43-43.t: His saying: ﴿لاَ يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ﴾ ("their gaze not returning to them"). You make "gaze" nominative by yartaddu, and you resume "hearts" and make them nominative by hawāʾ [i.e. «وأفئدتهم هواء», "and their hearts are void"]; as He said in Āl ʿImrān: ﴿وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُ إلاَّ اللهُ وَالرَّاسِخُونَ فىِ العِلْم﴾ ("none knows its interpretation except Allah; and those firm in knowledge…"): you resume them and make them nominative by "they say", not by "knows".

farraa:44-44.t:
His saying: ﴿يَأْتِيهِمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ﴾ ("the punishment comes to them, and [those who did wrong] will say"): nominative, following yaʾtīhim, and it is not an answer to the command. Had it been an answer, both accusative and nominative would be permissible, as the poet said:

يَا ناق سيرى عَنَقاً فسيحا * إلى سُليمان فنَستريحَا
(O she-camel, go at a broad, swift pace to Sulaymān, so that we may rest.)

The nominative is by resumption. Resuming with fāʾ in the answer to a command is good. We had an elder called al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Sayāba — he is the one who taught Muʿādh al-Harrāʾ and his companions — who used to say: I do not use the accusative with fāʾ as an answer to the command.

farraa:45-45.t: His saying: ﴿وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ﴾ ("and it became clear to you"); and the companions of ʿAbdullāh [read]: ﴿ونُبَيِّنْ لَكُمْ﴾ ("and We make clear to you").

farraa:46-46.t: His saying: ﴿وَإِن كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ ٱلْجِبَالُ﴾ ("though their plotting was not such that the mountains would be moved by it"). Most of the readers have kasra on the lām and the verb in the accusative in His saying ﴿لِتَزُولَ﴾, meaning: the mountains were not going to be moved by their plotting. ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd read (وَمَا كان مكرُهم لتزول منه الجبال) ("and their plotting was not such that the mountains would be moved by it"). Muḥammad narrated to us, saying: al-Farrāʾ narrated to us — one called Ghālib ibn Najīḥ, who was trustworthy and scrupulous [Translator's note: the chain appears defective in the text; something like "a man narrated to me…" seems to have dropped out] — that ʿAlī used to read: (وإنْ كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لَتَزُولُ مِنْه), with fatḥa on the first lām and ḍamma on the second [letter, i.e. the verb]. Whoever reads (وإنْ كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لَتَزُولُ مِنْه) does so in the sense of ʿAlī's reading, i.e. they plotted a mighty plot from which the mountains were almost moved.

farraa:47-47.t:
His saying: ﴿فَلاَ تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِ رُسُلَهُ﴾ ("so never think that Allah will fail His promise to His messengers"). You annex (مُخْلف) to "promise" and put "messengers" in the accusative according to the interpretation. When the verb falls upon two different things, like "I clothed you with the garment" and "I brought you into the house", begin by annexing the verbal [participle] to the man, so you say: "He is the clother of ʿAbdullāh with a garment, and the one bringing him into the house". It is also permissible: "He is the clother of the garment to ʿAbdullāh, and the bringer into the house of Zayd"; that is permissible because the verb can take "the house" just as it takes "ʿAbdullāh", so you say: "I brought into the house" and "I put on the garment". Similar to it is the saying of the poet:

ترى الثور فيها مُدخلَ الظلِّ رأسَه * وَسائره بادٍ إلى الشمس أجمعُ
(You see the wild bull in it putting into the shade his head, while the rest of him lies wholly exposed to the sun.)

He annexed (مُدْخل) to (الظل), whereas the proper way was to annex (مدخل) to (الرأس). Similar to it:

رُبّ ابن عمَّ لسُلَيمى مشمعلّْ * طبَّاخ سَاعاتِ الكرى زاد الكسِلْ
(Many a cousin of Sulaymā, brisk, cooking in the hours of slumber the provisions of the lazy one.)

And similar to it:

فرِشْنى بخير لا أكونَنْ ومِدْحتى * كناحت يوم صخرةً بعَسِيل
(So feather me with good, lest I and my praise be like one who one day chisels a rock with a [feather] brush.)

And another said:

* يا سارقَ الليلةِ أهلَ الدار *
(O you who rob this night the people of the house!)

He annexed "robber" to "the night" and put (أهل الدار) in the accusative. Some of the grammarians used to put (الليلة) in the accusative and (أهل) in the genitive, saying: "yā sāriqa al-laylata ahli al-dār".

* وكناحت يوماً صخرةٍ *
(And like one who chisels, one day, a rock.)

That is not good with a verbal [participle]; had it been a [pure] noun, what they said would be more permissible, as in your saying: "You are the owner, today, of a thousand dinars", because "owner" only takes one thing and does not take two, whereas a verb may make two things accusative. But when an adverbial phrase intervenes between the one putting into the genitive and what it puts into the genitive, its annexation is permissible, as in your saying: "This is the striker — in the house — of his brother"; but it is permissible only in poetry, as in his saying:

تروَّحَ فى عِمِّيَّةٍ وأَغاثه * عَلَى الماء قوم بالهراوات هُوجُ
مؤخِّر عن أنيابه جلدِ رأسه * لهنّ كأشباه الزِّجَاج خُرُوج
(He went off in blind confusion, and at the water a reckless band with clubs came to his aid — drawing back from his fangs the skin of his head, fangs that protrude like spearheads.)

And another said:

وكرَّار دونَ المجْحَرِين جَوادِه * إذا لم يُحَام دُون أنثى حَليلُهَا
(And one who wheels — in defence of those driven into their holes — his steed, when a woman's husband does not defend her.)

Al-Kisāʾī claimed that they prefer the accusative when they separate [the participle] annexed by an adverbial phrase, so they say: "He is the striker, for no reason, of his brother (akhāhu)", imagining, when they separate the two, that they have used tanwīn. The reading of whoever reads (مُخْلِفَ وَعْدَهُ رُسُلِه) is worthless, as is ﴿زُيِّنَ لِكَثِيرٍ مِنَ المُشْرِكِينَ قَتْلُ أَوْلاَدَهُمْ شُرَكائِهمْ﴾ ("the killing of their children by their partners was made fair-seeming to many of the polytheists"); that has been explained. The grammarians of the people of Medina recite his saying:

فَزَجَجْتُها مُتمَكِّناً * زَجَّ القَلوصَ أبى مَزَادَهْ
(I thrust at her firmly, as Abū Mazāda thrusts the young she-camel.)

Al-Farrāʾ said: that is false; the correct form is:

* زَجَّ القَلوصِ أبُو مَزَادَهْ *

farraa:50-50.t: His saying: ﴿سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍ﴾ ("their garments of pitch"). The generality of the readers agree that al-qaṭirān is a single word, like al-ẓaribān. Muḥammad narrated to us, saying: al-Farrāʾ narrated to us, saying: Ḥibbān narrated to me from al-Kalbī, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, that Ibn ʿAbbās explained it as ﴿مِنْ قِطْرآنٍ﴾: [molten brass] whose heat has reached its extreme; Ibn ʿAbbās read it so. Abū Zakariyyā said: and it is from His saying: ﴿قَالَ آتُونِى أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْراً﴾ ("he said: bring me molten brass to pour over it").

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿قل لعبادي الذين آمنوا يقيموا الصلاة﴾: ﴿قل﴾ is an imperative verb, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿لعبادي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿قل﴾; ﴿الذين﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عبادي﴾; the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and ﴿يقيموا﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by an implied (muqaddar) lām of command; the deletion of the lām is permitted because ﴿قُل﴾ indicates the command; and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent).
Or: ﴿يقيموا﴾ is a jussive imperfect verb as the answer to the command ﴿قُل﴾, and the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) is omitted, the implied form being: «قل لهم أقيموا الصلاة وأنفقوا مما رزقناكم يقيموا الصلاة وينفقوا مما رزقناهم» ("Say to them: establish the prayer and spend from what We have provided you, [and] they will establish the prayer and spend from what We have provided them").
Or: ﴿يقيموا﴾ is an imperfect verb turned from command to statement, its meaning being ﴿أقيموا﴾, and it was made indeclinable because it occupies the place of an indeclinable [form], so its nūn was deleted.
﴿وينفقوا مما رزقناهم سرا وعلانية﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ينفقوا﴾ is an imperfect verb conjoined to يقيموا, and the wāw of the plural is the agent; ﴿مما رزقناهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينفقوا﴾; and ﴿سرًّا وعلانية﴾ are both accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "keeping it secret and making it public"; or as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "a spending of secrecy and openness"; or as adverbs, i.e. "at the two times of secrecy and openness"; or by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in secrecy and openness".
﴿من قبل أن يأتي يوم لا بيع فيه ولا خلال﴾: ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينفقوا﴾; أن and what falls in its scope is a maṣdar that is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿يوم﴾ is the agent of ﴿يأتي﴾; لا is negative; بيع is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿فيه﴾ is the khabar (predicate); and ﴿لا خلال﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لا بيع﴾.
﴿وسخر لكم الشمس والقمر دائبين وسخر لكم الليل والنهار﴾: also a conjunction [of what precedes]; and دائبين is a ḥāl of الشمس and القمر. [Translator's note: this last line belongs to verse 33 of this surah (it is repeated there as the entry for 14:33); it appears to have been carried over here from the neighbouring verse and is translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿الله الذي خلق السماوات والأرض﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الذي is its khabar (predicate); خلق is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; and السماوات والأرض is its object.
﴿وأنزل من السماء ماء فأخرج به من الثمرات رزقا لكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنزل is conjoined to خلق, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); ﴿من السماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أنزل﴾; ﴿ماء﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فأخرج﴾ is conjoined to أنزل; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أخرج﴾; ﴿من الثمرات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); رزقًا is the direct object; and ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رزقًا﴾. Or ﴿من الثمرات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted [word] which is the direct object, and ﴿رزقا﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or a ḥāl.
﴿وسخر لكم الفلك لتجري في البحر بأمره﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿سخر لكم الفلك﴾ is conjoined to what precedes; ﴿لتجري﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and تجري is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to سخر; ﴿في البحر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجري﴾; and ﴿بأمره﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿وسخر لكم الأنهار﴾: conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿وسخر لكم الشمس والقمر دائبين وسخر لكم الليل والنهار﴾: also a conjunction [of what precedes]; and دائبين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الشمس and القمر.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿وآتاكم من كل ما سألتموه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; آتاكم is likewise conjoined, and it is a verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من كل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿آتاكم﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative [noun], muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and سألتموه is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. It is also said that ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).
﴿وإن تعدوا نعمت الله لا تحصوها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; تعدوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); نعمة الله is the object of ﴿تعدوا﴾; لا is negative; and تحصوها is the apodosis of إن.
﴿إن الإنسان لظلوم كفار﴾: a resumptive clause (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الإنسان is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ظلوم is the first khabar (predicate) of إن, and كفار is the second khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿وإذ قال إبراهيم رب اجعل هذا البلد آمنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); the clause ﴿قال﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); إبراهيم is the fāʿil (agent); رب is the one addressed (munādā), from which the vocative particle has been omitted, annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, which has been omitted; ﴿اجعل﴾ is a verb of supplication, and its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿هذا﴾ is its first object; البلد is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; and آمنًا is the second direct object.
﴿واجنبني وبني أن نعبد الأصنام﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اجنبني is a verb of supplication, the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is its object; ﴿بني﴾ is conjoined to the yāʾ, or is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); ﴿أن نعبد﴾: أن and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «عن أن نعبد» ("from worshipping"), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿اجنبني﴾; and الأصنام is the direct object of نعبد.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿رب إنهن أضللن كثيرا من الناس﴾: رب is the one addressed (munādā), from which the vocative particle has been omitted, annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, which has been omitted; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause أضللن is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and the pronoun refers back to the idols; كثيرًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من الناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كثيرًا﴾; and the clause ﴿إنهن﴾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) for His saying: ﴿واجنبني﴾.
﴿فمن تبعني فإنه مني﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; من is a conditional noun that makes [the verb] jussive, and it is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿تبعني﴾ is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the direct object; ﴿فإنه﴾: the fāʾ links (rābiṭa) the apodosis, إن is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; ﴿مني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the verb and its apodosis are the khabar of من.
﴿ومن عصاني فإنك غفور رحيم﴾: a clause conjoined to its counterpart.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿ربنا إني أسكنت من ذريتي بواد غير ذي زرع عند بيتك المحرم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the yāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause أسكنت is its khabar (predicate); ﴿من ذريتي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the omitted object of أسكنت, i.e. «أسكنت ذرية من ذريتي» ("I have settled some offspring of my offspring"), and من is partitive; ﴿بواد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أسكنت﴾; ﴿غير﴾ is an adjective of واد; ذي is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and زرع is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿عند بيتك﴾: the adverb is attached to an omitted adjective of واد; and المحرم is an adjective of بيتك.
﴿ربنا ليقيموا الصلاة﴾: ﴿ليقيموا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the verb is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أسكنت.
﴿فاجعل أفئدة من الناس تهوي إليهم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; اجعل أفئدة is a verb of supplication and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من الناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿أفئدة﴾; the clause تهوي is the second direct object of ﴿اجعل﴾; and ﴿إليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تهوي﴾.
﴿وارزقهم من الثمرات لعلهم يشكرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ارزقهم is conjoined to اجعل; ﴿من الثمرات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ارزقهم﴾, i.e. "some of the fruits", so من is partitive; لعل is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause يشكرون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿ربنا إنك تعلم ما نخفي وما نعلن﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the kāf is its noun (ism); the clause تعلم is its khabar (predicate); ﴿ما﴾ is the object of تعلم; the clause نخفي is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿ما نعلن﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما نخفي﴾.
﴿وما يخفى على الله من شيء في الأرض ولا في السماء﴾: ما is negative; يخفى is an imperfect verb; ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿يخفى﴾; من is a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant]; شيء is genitive by من in form and fāʿil (agent) in position; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of شيء; and ﴿ولا في السماء﴾ is conjoined to ﴿في الأرض﴾.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿الحمد لله الذي وهب لي على الكبر إسماعيل وإسحاق﴾: الحمد is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate); الذي is a naʿt (adjective) of لله; the clause وهب is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وهب﴾; ﴿على الكبر﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and على has the meaning of «مع» ("with/despite"); إسماعيل is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and إسحاق is conjoined to it.
﴿إن ربي لسميع الدعاء﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ربي is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); سميع الدعاء is its khabar; and the clause gives the reason for His saying: ﴿وهب لي على الكبر﴾.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿رب اجعلني مقيم الصلاة﴾: اجعلني is a verb of supplication; the yāʾ is its first object, and مقيم الصلاة is its second object.
﴿ومن ذريتي ربنا وتقبل دعاء﴾: ﴿ومن ذريتي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted [word] conjoined to the yāʾ of the first person; ﴿ربنا﴾ is the one addressed (munādā); تقبل is conjoined to what precedes; and دعائي is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the yāʾ having been deleted in keeping with the verse-endings (fawāṣil).

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿ربنا اغفر لي ولوالدي وللمؤمنين يوم يقوم الحساب﴾: اغفر is a verb of supplication; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿اغفر﴾; لوالدي and للمؤمنين are conjoined to ﴿لي﴾; and يوم is an adverb of time attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. while the forgiveness is on that dire day.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿ولا تحسبن الله غافلا عما يعمل الظالمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive; تحسبن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the Name of Majesty is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); غافلًا is the second direct object; ﴿عما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿غافلًا﴾; and the clause يعمل الظالمون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنما يؤخرهم ليوم تشخص فيه الأبصار﴾: the clause is likewise resumptive with no grammatical position; إنما is [إنّ] restrained [from governing] by [ما] the restraining [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); يؤخرهم is an imperfect verb, a latent agent and a direct object; ﴿ليوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤخرهم﴾; the clause تشخص is a naʿt (adjective) of يوم; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تشخص﴾; and الأبصار is the agent.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿مهطعين مقنعي رءوسهم لا يرتد إليهم طرفهم﴾: ﴿مهطعين﴾ and ﴿مقنعي رءوسهم﴾ are two ḥāls (circumstantials); and the clause ﴿لا يرتد إليهم طرفهم﴾ is a third ḥāl, from the pronoun in ﴿مقنعي رؤوسهم﴾; it is also said to be resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position.
﴿وأفئدتهم هواء﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; أفئدتهم هواء is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is a fourth ḥāl. Or the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿وأنذر الناس يوم يأتيهم العذاب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنذر is conjoined to His saying: ﴿ولا تحسبن﴾; الناس is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); يوم is the second direct object; the clause يأتيهم العذاب is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿يأتيهم﴾ is a verb and a direct object; and العذاب is the postponed fāʿil (agent).
﴿فيقول الذين ظلموا ربنا أخرنا إلى أجل قريب نجب دعوتك ونتبع الرسل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿يقول﴾ is conjoined to يأتيهم; الذين is the agent; the clause ظلموا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿ربنا﴾ is an annexed one addressed (munādā muḍāf); ﴿أخرنا﴾ is a verb of supplication, a latent (mustatir) agent and a direct object; ﴿إلى أجل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿أخرنا﴾; قريب is a naʿt (adjective); ﴿نجب﴾ is jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the agent is latent, its implied form being "we" (نحن); and دعوتك is the direct object.
﴿أولم تكونوا أقسمتم من قبل ما لكم من زوال﴾: the hamza is for the rebuking, affirmative interrogative; the wāw is a conjunction; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and jussive; تكونوا is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive by ﴿لم﴾, and the wāw is its noun (ism); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) [of a saying that is] omitted, i.e. "so this saying is said to them by way of rebuke and reproach"; the clause أقسمتم is the khabar (predicate) of تكونوا; ﴿ما﴾ is negative; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant]; ﴿زوال﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative in position and genitive by ﴿من﴾ in form; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿وسكنتم في مساكن الذين ظلموا أنفسهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; سكنتم is conjoined to أقسمتم, and it is a verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿في مساكن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿سكنتم﴾; الذين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ظلموا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and أنفسهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وتبين لكم كيف فعلنا بهم وضربنا لكم الأمثال﴾: ﴿وتبين﴾ is conjoined to what precedes, and the agent is implied (muqaddar) from what the clause expresses, i.e. "their condition"; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تبين﴾; ﴿كيف﴾ stands as deputy for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "what kind of doing We did to them", or it is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فعلنا﴾ is a verb and agent; ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿فعلنا﴾; the clause ﴿ضربنا...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿تبين...﴾, or it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; ضربنا is a verb and agent; الأمثال is the direct object; and ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ضربنا﴾.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿وقد مكروا مكرهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); مكروا is a verb and fāʿil (agent); and مكرهم is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿وعند الله مكرهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; عند الله is an adverb attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مكرهم is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وإن كان مكرهم لتزول منه الجبال﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is negative; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; مكرهم is its noun (ism); the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); تزول is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of denial; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of كان; ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تزول; and الجبال is the agent.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿فلا تحسبن الله مخلف وعده رسله﴾: a consequential conjunction (ʿaṭf tafrīʿī) to ﴿ولا تحسبن﴾; لا is prohibitive; تحسبن is jussive (majzūm) in position by the prohibitive ﴿لا﴾; the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); مخلف is the second object of ﴿تحسبن﴾; مخلف is an active participle that governs as the verb does; وعده is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is its [i.e. the participle's] second object; and رسله is its first object, the original order being «مخلف رسله وعده».
﴿إن الله عزيز ذو انتقام﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); عزيز is its khabar (predicate); and ذو انتقام is its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿يوم تبدل الأرض غير الأرض والسماوات﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿انتقام﴾ or to ﴿مخلف﴾; or it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); or a badal (substitute) from ﴿يوم﴾ in His saying (Exalted is He) ﴿يوم يأتيهم العذاب﴾; the clause ﴿تبدل﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); تبدل is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); الأرض is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); غير الأرض is the second object of ﴿تبدل﴾; and السماوات is conjoined to الأرض.
﴿وبرزوا لله الواحد القهار﴾: conjoined to تبدل, so it is a past [verb] with the meaning of the imperfect; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿برزوا﴾; and الواحد and القهار are two naʿts (adjectives) of الله.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿وترى المجرمين يومئذ مقرنين في الأصفاد﴾: likewise conjoined to تبدل; المجرمين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the seeing here is visual; ﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم is an adverb of time attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿ترى﴾, and إذٍ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn, because the place [of the vowel] is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being: «يوم إذ برزوا لله» ("the day when they come forth to Allah"), or «يوم إذ تبدل الأرض» ("the day when the earth is changed"), or «يوم إذ ينجز وعده» ("the day when He fulfils His promise"); مقرنين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of المجرمين; and ﴿في الأصفاد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مقرنين﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿سرابيلهم من قطران﴾: the clause is a second ḥāl (circumstantial), or a resumptive clause (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position; سرابيلهم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); and ﴿من قطران﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿وتغشى وجوههم النار﴾: conjoined to the circumstantial clause; تغشى is an imperfect verb; وجوههم is the fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and النار is the postponed fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿ليجزي الله كل نفس ما كسبت﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); يجزي is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq) to ﴿برزوا﴾; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿كل نفس﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿ما كسبت﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is the second direct object, and the clause كسبت is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله سريع الحساب﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); سريع is its khabar (predicate); and the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿هذا بلاغ للناس ولينذروا به﴾: هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); بلاغ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿للناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective); لينذروا is conjoined to something omitted, i.e. «لينصحوا ويحذروا» ("so that they may be counselled and warned"); and ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينذروا﴾.
﴿وليعلموا أنما هو إله واحد وليذكر أولو الألباب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ليعلموا is conjoined to لينذروا; أنما is [أنّ] restrained [from governing] by [ما] the restraining [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa), and it has filled the place of the two objects of يعلموا; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; إله is the khabar; واحد is an adjective; ليذكر is conjoined to what precedes; and أولو الألباب is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿الر﴾: The discussion of the disconnected letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.
﴿كتاب أنزلناه إليك لتخرج الناس من الظلمات إلى النور﴾: كتاب is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "هذا كتاب" (this is a Book); the clause أنزلناه is an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿إليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزلناه; the lām is the lām of reason (taʿlīl); تخرج is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of reason; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from the implied أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أنزلناه; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت"; الناس is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من الظلمات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تخرج﴾, and ﴿إلى النور﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to ﴿تخرج﴾.
﴿بإذن ربهم إلى صراط العزيز الحميد﴾: ﴿بإذن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "in the state of your being permitted by your Lord"; ربهم is the muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿إلى صراط﴾ is a badal (substitute) from His words ﴿إلى النور﴾; العزيز is the muḍāf ilayhi, and الحميد an adjective.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿قالت رسلهم أفي الله شك﴾: a resumptive clause built on an implied question that the context calls for, as though it were said: "So what did their messengers say?"; ﴿في الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate), and شك is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); or ﴿شك﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of what the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿في الله﴾ are attached to, since it rests on the interrogative.
﴿فاطر السماوات والأرض يدعوكم ليغفر لكم من ذنوبكم﴾: فاطر is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿الله﴾, or a badal (substitute) from it; the clause يدعوكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, i.e. "in the state of His calling you to faith by sending us"; the lām is for giving a reason (taʿlīl); يغفر is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of reason; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يدعوكم﴾; ﴿من ذنوبكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يغفر﴾; it is said that ﴿مِن﴾ is partitive, it is said that it is for substitution (badal), and it is said that it is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant).
﴿ويؤخركم إلى أجل مسمى﴾: the واو is a conjunction; يؤخركم is conjoined to يغفر; ﴿إلى أجل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يؤخركم﴾; مسمى is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أجل﴾.
﴿قالوا إن أنتم إلا بشر مثلنا﴾: إن is negative; أنتم is the mubtadaʾ; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); بشر is the khabar, and مثلنا an adjective.
﴿تريدون أن تصدونا عما كان يعبد آباؤنا﴾: the clause تريدون is a second adjective of ﴿بشر﴾, or resumptive with no grammatical position; ﴿تريدون﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن﴾ and what falls in its scope is the object of تريدون; ﴿عما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تصدونا﴾; the clause كان is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), or a pronoun referring to ﴿ما﴾; the clause يعبد is the khabar of كان; آباؤنا is the fāʿil of يعبد, and the object is omitted, referring to ﴿ما﴾, or to the pronoun of the matter.
﴿فأتونا بسلطان مبين﴾: the فاء is the فاء of eloquence (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); ائتونا is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بسلطان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ائتونا﴾; مبين is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿قالت لهم رسلهم إن نحن إلا بشر مثلكم﴾: ﴿قالت لهم رسلهم﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قالت﴾; إن is negative; نحن is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); بشر is the khabar (predicate), and مثلكم an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿ولكن الله يمن على من يشاء من عباده﴾: the واو is for the ḥāl (circumstantial), or a conjunction; لكن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿يمن﴾ is its khabar; ﴿على من﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يمن﴾; the clause يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿من عباده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿وما كان لنا أن نأتيكم بسلطان إلا بإذن الله﴾: the واو is a conjunction; كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted, advanced khabar of كان; أن and what it enters upon, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), is the delayed noun of كان; ﴿بسلطان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نأتيكم﴾; إلا is a particle of restriction; ﴿بإذن الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "clothed with Allah's permission".
﴿وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يتوكل﴾; the فاء is also a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; يتوكل is an imperfect verb made jussive by the lām of command; المؤمنون is the fāʿil of يتوكل.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿وما لنا ألا نتوكل على الله﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ما is interrogative, in the position of nominative as the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); أن together with what falls in its scope is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نتوكل﴾.
﴿وقد هدانا سبلنا﴾: the واو is for the ḥāl; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); هدانا is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); سبلنا is accusative by removal of the preposition.
﴿ولنصبرن على ما آذيتمونا﴾: the واو is a conjunction; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; ﴿نصبرن﴾ is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; ﴿على ما﴾: على is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; آذيتمونا is a verb, its fāʿil and its object, the واو being for lengthening (ishbāʿ); it is also said that ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, i.e. "for that with which you have harmed us".
﴿وعلى الله فليتوكل المتوكلون﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يتوكل﴾; the فاء is also a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; ﴿يتوكل﴾ is an imperfect verb made jussive by the lām of command; المتوكلون is the fāʿil of يتوكل.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وقال الذين كفروا لرسلهم لنخرجنكم من أرضنا﴾: ﴿قال الذين﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿لرسلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; نخرجنكم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من أرضنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نخرجنكم﴾; the clause is the speech reported by the verb "said" (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿أو لتعودن في ملتنا﴾: أو is a conjunction meaning إلا (unless); لتعودن is conjoined to نخرجنكم, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the واو of the plural, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil; the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis; ﴿في ملتنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تعودن﴾, or it is its khabar (predicate).
﴿فأوحى إليهم ربهم لنهلكن الظالمين﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; أوحى إليهم ربهم is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿لنهلكن﴾: the lām is the answer to the omitted oath. ﴿نهلكن الظالمين﴾ is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿لنهلكن الظالمين﴾ is the answer to an implied oath, with no grammatical position. The oath and its answer form an explicative clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ولنسكننكم الأرض من بعدهم﴾: the واو is a conjunction; نسكننكم is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الأرض is accusative by removal of the preposition, or a mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); ﴿من بعدهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نسكننكم﴾; it is also said to be a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ذلك لمن خاف مقامي وخاف وعيد﴾: ذلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause خاف is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; ﴿مقامي﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; خاف is a past verb; وعيد is the mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the first-person ياء, which is dropped to observe the verse endings (fawāṣil).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿واستفتحوا﴾: the واو is a conjunction; استفتحوا is a past verb meaning "they sought victory", and the واو is the fāʿil (agent); the pronoun refers to the messengers; it is also said to refer to the unbelievers.
﴿وخاب كل جبار عنيد﴾: the واو is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it; خاب كل جبار is a verb and its fāʿil; عنيد is an adjective (ṣifa) of جبار.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿من ورائه جهنم ويسقى من ماء صديد﴾: ﴿من ورائه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate); جهنم is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is a second adjective (ṣifa) of جبار; ﴿ويسقى﴾: the واو conjoins to something implied; يسقى is an imperfect verb in the passive (built on the form whose agent is not named); ﴿من ماء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يسقى﴾; صديد is a badal (substitute) from ماء, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it; it is also said to be a naʿt (adjective) of ماء, and it is also said to be a naʿt with the particle of comparison dropped, the implied form being "مثل صديد" (like pus); the clause يسقى is conjoined to something omitted, its implied form being: "behind him is Hell, in which he meets what he meets, of severe water distinguished from its punishment" [Translator's note: so in the source: ماء شديد يتميز عن عذابها].

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿يتجرعه ولا يكاد يسيغه﴾: the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of ماء; يتجرعه is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it is also said that the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿ولا﴾: the واو is a conjunction, and لا is negative; ﴿يكاد﴾ is one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba), and its noun is latent, its implied form being "هو"; the clause ﴿يسيغه﴾ is the khabar (predicate).
﴿ويأتيه الموت من كل مكان﴾: the واو is a conjunction; يأتيه الموت is a verb, a delayed fāʿil and an advanced object; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted that is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "the causes of death come to him, surrounding him from all sides".
﴿وما هو بميت ومن ورائه عذاب غليظ﴾: the واو is for the ḥāl; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative particle, operating like ليس; ﴿هو﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿بميت﴾: the باء is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and ﴿ميت﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative by position and genitive in form by the باء; ﴿من ورائه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar; عذاب is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); غليظ is an adjective of عذاب.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿مثل الذين كفروا بربهم أعمالهم كرماد اشتدت به الريح في يوم عاصف﴾: مثل الذين is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: "and among what is narrated to you is the likeness"; the clause ﴿كفروا بربهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; أعمالهم is a mubtadaʾ, and the كاف is the khabar, meaning مثل (like), or it is a particle that, with its genitive noun, is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. It is also said: ﴿مثل﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, أعمالهم a second mubtadaʾ, and ﴿كرماد﴾ the khabar of the second, the second with its khabar being the khabar of the first. It is also said: ﴿مثل﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, أعمالهم is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from it, and ﴿كرماد﴾ is the khabar of ﴿مثل﴾ and ﴿أعمالهم﴾ together. The clause اشتدت به الريح is an adjective (ṣifa) of رماد; ﴿في يوم عاصف﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اشتدت﴾; it is also said to be a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الريح.
﴿لا يقدرون مما كسبوا على شيء﴾: the clause is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of كفروا; يقدرون is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿مما كسبوا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from ﴿شيء﴾; ﴿على شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يقدرون﴾; the clause كسبوا is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ذلك هو الضلال البعيد﴾: ذلك is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿هو﴾ is a second mubtadaʾ; الضلال is the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ, the second with its khabar being the khabar of the first; ﴿البعيد﴾ is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الله خلق السماوات والأرض بالحق﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); لم is a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; ﴿تر﴾ is an imperfect verb made jussive by ﴿لم﴾; أن together with what falls in its scope takes the place of the two objects of ﴿تر﴾; السماوات is the object of خلق; ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلق, the باء being causal, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the باء being for accompaniment (muṣāḥaba).
﴿إن يشأ يذهبكم ويأت بخلق جديد﴾: إن is conditional; يشأ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿يذهبكم﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); يأت is conjoined to يذهبكم; ﴿بخلق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يأت﴾; جديد is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿الله الذي له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: ﴿الله﴾ is a badal (substitute) from, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to, العزيز الحميد; ﴿الذي﴾ is its adjective (ṣifa); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate); ﴿ما﴾ is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿في السماوات﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿وما في الأرض﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾.
﴿وويل للكافرين من عذاب شديد﴾: ويل is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause is one of imprecation (duʿāʾiyya), with no grammatical position; ﴿للكافرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; ﴿من﴾ is explicative (bayāniyya), and ﴿من عذاب﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ويل﴾; or ﴿من﴾ is for making transitive (taʿdiya), and ﴿من عذاب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ويل﴾; شديد is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿وما ذلك على الله بعزيز﴾: the واو: a conjunction, or for the ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative particle, operating like ليس; ﴿ذلك﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عزيز﴾; ﴿بعزيز﴾: the باء is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and ﴿عزيز﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative by position and genitive in form by the باء.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وبرزوا لله جميعا﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; برزوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿برزوا﴾; جميعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فقال الضعفاء للذين استكبروا﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; ﴿قال الضعفاء﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قال﴾; the clause استكبروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنا كنا لكم تبعا﴾: إنّا: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause ﴿إنا﴾ is the speech reported by the verb "said" (maqūl al-qawl); كنا is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause ﴿كنا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; تبعًا is the khabar of كنا.
﴿فهل أنتم مغنون عنا من عذاب الله من شيء﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; هل is an interrogative particle; أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and مغنون the khabar; ﴿عنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مغنون﴾; ﴿من عذاب الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; the second ﴿مِن﴾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); شيء is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by position, genitive in form by من.
﴿قالوا لو هدانا الله لهديناكم سواء علينا أجزعنا أم صبرنا﴾: قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil; لو is a particle of non-occurrence (imtināʿ); ﴿هدانا الله﴾ is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil; ﴿لهديناكم﴾: the lām occurs in the answer of the condition, and هديناكم is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿سواء﴾ is the advanced khabar; ﴿أجزعنا﴾ is the delayed mubtadaʾ, because it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), since the hamza is for equalization (taswiya) and the verb after it is interpreted as a maṣdar; أم is a connected (muttaṣila) conjunction; صبرنا is conjoined to جزعنا.
﴿ما لنا من محيص﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is negative; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar; ﴿مِن﴾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; ﴿محيص﴾ is the delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative by position and genitive in form by ﴿مِن﴾.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿وقال الشيطان لما قضي الأمر﴾: the واو is a conjunction; قال الشيطان is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); لما is adverbial, temporal (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or a linking particle (rābiṭa); ﴿قضي الأمر﴾ is a verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is in the position of genitive through the annexation of the adverb to it, or has no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله وعدكم وعد الحق﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿وعدكم﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿وعد﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and الحق is the muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿إن الله﴾ is the speech reported by the verb "said" (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ووعدتكم فأخلفتكم﴾: the واو is a conjunction; وعدتكم is conjoined to وعدكم; فأخلفتكم is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is conjoined to وعدتكم.
﴿وما كان لي عليكم من سلطان إلا أن دعوتكم فاستجبتم لي﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ما is negative; كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted, advanced khabar; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective (ṣifa) of سلطان; من is a preposition, and سلطان is genitive in form and the noun of كان by position; إلا is a particle of exception; أن together with what falls in its scope is the excepted (mustathnā); فاستجبتم is conjoined to دعوتكم; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿استجبتم﴾.
﴿فلا تلوموني ولوموا أنفسكم﴾: the فاء is the فاء of eloquence (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), as though it were said: "If you know that you hastened to answer me, then you are the ones to blame"; لا is the prohibitive lā; تلوموني is an imperfect verb made jussive by the prohibitive لا; the واو is the fāʿil, the نون is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the ياء is the mafʿūl bihi; لوموا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; أنفسكم is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ما أنا بمصرخكم وما أنتم بمصرخي﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative particle, operating like ليس; ﴿أنا﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿بمصرخكم﴾: the باء is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and ﴿مصرخكم﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative by position and genitive in form by the باء; ﴿وما أنتم بمصرخي﴾ is conjoined to its counterpart.
﴿إني كفرت بما أشركتمون من قبل﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, the ياء is its noun, and the clause كفرت is its khabar; the باء is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with ﴿أشركتموني﴾ as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the باء; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿كفرت﴾, i.e. "I disbelieve in your associating me [with Allah]"; it is also said that it is a relative noun; the ياء is the object of ﴿أشركتموني﴾; ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أشركتموني﴾.
﴿إن الظالمين لهم عذاب أليم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, and الظالمين is its noun; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar; عذاب is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); أليم is an adjective; the nominal clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿وأدخل الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; أدخل is a past verb in the passive (built on the form whose agent is not named); الذين is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; عملوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿عملوا﴾ is conjoined to آمنوا; الصالحات is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); جنات is a second mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); the clause ﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿جنات﴾.
﴿بإذن ربهم تحيتهم فيها سلام﴾: ﴿بإذن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أدخل﴾; ﴿ربهم﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi; تحيتهم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); سلام is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿تحيتهم﴾.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿ألم تر كيف ضرب الله مثلا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); لم is a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; ﴿تر﴾ is an imperfect verb made jussive by ﴿لم﴾, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of ضرب; ﴿ضرب الله مثلًا﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿كلمة طيبة كشجرة طيبة﴾: كلمة is a badal (substitute) from ﴿مثلًا﴾, or a second mafʿūl bihi through ضرب implicitly carrying the meaning of جعل (make); ﴿كشجرة﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "it is like a good tree"; شجرة: muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿طيبة﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of شجرة.
﴿أصلها ثابت وفرعها في السماء﴾: ﴿أصلها﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and ثابت its khabar, and the clause is a second adjective of شجرة; ﴿فرعها في السماء﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أصلها ثابت﴾.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿تؤتي أكلها كل حين بإذن ربها﴾: the clause is a third adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿شجرة﴾; تؤتي is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هي"; أكلها is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿كل حين﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تؤتي﴾; ﴿بإذن ربها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تؤتي﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "clothed with the permission of its Lord".
﴿ويضرب الله الأمثال للناس لعلهم يتذكرون﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; يضرب الله الأمثال is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿للناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يضرب﴾; لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the هاء is its noun, and the clause ﴿يتذكرون﴾ is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿ومثل كلمة خبيثة كشجرة خبيثة اجتثت من فوق الأرض ما لها من قرار﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿مثل﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿كلمة﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿خبيثة﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿كشجرة﴾: the كاف is a noun meaning مِثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; شجرة: muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿خبيثة﴾ is an adjective; the clause ﴿اجتثت من فوق الأرض﴾ is a second adjective of شجرة; ﴿ما﴾ is negative; ﴿لها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, advanced khabar; ﴿مِن﴾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; ﴿قرار﴾ is the delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative by position and genitive in form by ﴿مِن﴾; the clause ﴿ما لها من قرار﴾ is a third adjective of شجرة.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿يثبت الله الذين آمنوا بالقول الثابت في الحياة الدنيا وفي الآخرة﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; يثبت is an imperfect verb, ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent), and الذين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿بالقول﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يثبت﴾; الثابت is a naʿt (adjective) of القول; ﴿في الحياة الدنيا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ويضل الله الظالمين ويفعل الله ما يشاء﴾: ﴿ويضل الله الظالمين﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿ويفعل الله ما يشاء﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause يشاء is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿ألم تر إلى الذين بدلوا نعمت الله كفرا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of wonder (istifhām taʿajjubī); لم is a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; ﴿إلى الذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تر﴾; the clause بدلوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; نعمة الله is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ﴿كفرًا﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وأحلوا قومهم دار البوار﴾: أحلوا is conjoined to بدلوا; قومهم is the first mafʿūl bihi, and دار البوار the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿جهنم يصلونها﴾: جهنم is a badal (substitute) from, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to, ﴿دار البوار﴾, and the clause ﴿يصلونها﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause; or ﴿جهنم﴾ is accusative by an omitted verb indicated by what follows it, i.e. "they will burn in Hell", and the clause ﴿يصلونها﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl from His words ﴿قومهم﴾ in the preceding ayah, or explicative of an implied verb that makes جهنم accusative, and so has no grammatical position, the implied form being: "they will burn in Hell, they will burn in it".
﴿وبئس القرار﴾: the واو is for the ḥāl; بئس is a rigid (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; القرار is the fāʿil (agent), nominative; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "هي" (it).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿الذين يستحبون الحياة الدنيا على الآخرة﴾: الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of الكافرين, or a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is the coming clause ﴿أولئك في ضلال بعيد﴾, or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "they are those who prefer"; the clause ﴿يستحبون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; الحياة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الدنيا an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿على الآخرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستحبون﴾.
﴿ويصدون عن سبيل الله ويبغونها عوجا﴾: the واو is a conjunction; يصدون is conjoined to يستحبون; ﴿عن سبيل الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يصدون﴾; يبغونها is conjoined to يصدون; يبغون is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿ها﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "يبغون لها" (they seek for it); عوجًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the هاء in ﴿يبغونها﴾.
﴿أولئك في ضلال بعيد﴾: the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿في ضلال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; بعيد is an adjective of ضلال.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿وجعلوا لله أندادا ليضلوا عن سبيله﴾: the واو is a conjunction; جعلوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted that is accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of جعلوا, and أندادًا is the first mafʿūl bihi; or ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿ليضلوا﴾: the lām is the lām of consequence (ʿāqiba), or of outcome (ṣayrūra); it is also said to be the lām of reason (taʿlīl); يضلوا is accusative by an implied أن after the lām of consequence or the lām of reason; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to جعلوا; the واو is the fāʿil; ﴿عن سبيله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يضلوا﴾.
﴿قل تمتعوا﴾: ﴿قل﴾ is an imperative verb; the clause ﴿تمتعوا﴾ is the speech reported by the verb "say" (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿تمتعوا﴾ is an imperative verb and its fāʿil.
﴿فإن مصيركم إلى النار﴾: the فاء is for giving a reason (taʿlīl); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); مصيركم is its noun; ﴿إلى النار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿وما أرسلنا من رسول إلا بلسان قومه ليبين لهم﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); رسول is genitive in form, accusative by position as the object; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿بلسان قومه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "clothed with the tongue of his people", so it is an exception from the most general of states; ﴿ليبين﴾: the lām is for giving a reason (taʿlīl), and ﴿يبين﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of reason; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أرسلنا; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يبين﴾.
﴿فيضل الله من يشاء ويهدي من يشاء﴾: the فاء is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; يضل is an imperfect verb, nominative because of resumption; ﴿يضل الله﴾ is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; ﴿مَن﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿ويهدي من يشاء﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يضل الله من يشاء﴾.
﴿وهو العزيز الحكيم﴾: ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); العزيز is the first khabar (predicate) and الحكيم the second khabar.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿ولقد أرسلنا موسى بآياتنا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); موسى is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بآياتنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "accompanied by Our signs and strengthened by them".
﴿أن أخرج قومك من الظلمات إلى النور﴾: أن is explicative (tafsīriyya) or maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from ﴿أن أخرج﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, the implied form being "بأن أخرج قومك" (that you bring your people out), and the preposition and its genitive noun, made up of the باء and the interpreted maṣdar, are attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾. ﴿قومك﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أخرج﴾; ﴿من الظلمات إلى النور﴾: the prepositions and their genitive nouns are attached to ﴿أخرج﴾. The clause ﴿أخرج﴾ is explicative, or the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿أن﴾, and on both construals it has no grammatical position.
﴿وذكرهم بأيام الله﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿ذكرهم﴾ is an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بأيام الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ذكرهم﴾.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لكل صبار شكور﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted, advanced khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) for emphasis; آيات is the delayed noun of إن; ﴿لكل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa); صبار is the muḍāf ilayhi, and ﴿شكور﴾ is an adjective of ﴿صبار﴾.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿وإذ قال موسى لقومه اذكروا نعمة الله عليكم﴾: the واو is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember), i.e. "and remember the time when Mūsā said to his people"; the clause ﴿قال موسى﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿لقومه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; اذكروا is an imperative verb, and the واو is the fāʿil (agent); نعمة الله is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "remember His bestowing upon you", or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿نعمة الله﴾ if it is taken as a noun, i.e. "remember His favour, being upon you".
﴿إذ أنجاكم من آل فرعون﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) of ﴿نعمة الله﴾, attached to it on the construal of ﴿نعمة﴾ as a maṣdar; or it is a noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from ﴿نعمة الله﴾; the clause ﴿أنجاكم﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation; ﴿من آل فرعون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أنجاكم﴾.
﴿يسومونكم سوء العذاب ويذبحون أبناءكم ويستحيون نساءكم﴾: three ḥāls from آل فرعون, or from the pronoun of those addressed.
﴿وفي ذلكم بلاء من ربكم عظيم﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿في ذلكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar (predicate); بلاء is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من ربكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of بلاء; عظيم is a second adjective.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وإذ تأذن ربكم لئن شكرتم لأزيدنكم﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative by conjunction to ﴿نعمة الله﴾, the implied form being: "remember Allah's favour upon you, and remember when your Lord proclaimed"; or ﴿إذ﴾ is conjoined to the earlier ﴿إذ﴾ in the words of the Exalted ﴿إذ أنجاكم﴾; the clause ﴿تأذن﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ربكم is the fāʿil (agent) of تأذن; the clause ﴿لئن شكرتم﴾ is the speech reported by an omitted verb of saying; or تأذن is treated like قال, since it is a kind of saying, so there is no need to imply a verb of saying; the lām paves the way for the oath (mūṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); إن is conditional; شكرتم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿لأزيدنكم﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and the clause لأزيدنكم has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath.
﴿ولئن كفرتم﴾: a clause conjoined to its counterpart; the answer to the oath is omitted, but it is implicitly indicated by His words ﴿إن عذابي لشديد﴾, i.e. "لأعذبنكم" (I will surely punish you).
﴿إن عذابي لشديد﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), عذابي is its noun, and شديد its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t: ﴿وقال موسى إن تكفروا أنتم ومن في الأرض جميعا فإن الله لغني حميد﴾: ﴿وقال موسى﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause إن تكفروا is the speech reported by the verb "said" (maqūl al-qawl); إن is conditional; تكفروا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the واو is the fāʿil; أنتم is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the واو; ﴿مَن﴾ is conjoined to the واو; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; جميعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the فاء is linking; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and غني حميد are two khabars (predicates) of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿ألم يأتكم نبأ الذين من قبلكم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); لم is a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; يأت is an imperfect verb made jussive by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the كاف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); نبأ is the fāʿil (agent), and الذين is the muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿من قبلكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause).
﴿قوم نوح وعاد وثمود﴾: قوم: a badal (substitute) from ﴿الذين﴾. نوح: muḍāf ilayhi. عاد and ثمود: conjoined.
﴿والذين من بعدهم﴾: the واو is a conjunction. الذين: conjoined to ﴿قوم﴾, in the position of genitive, or conjoined to ﴿الذين من قبلكم﴾, or a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is the clause ﴿لا يعلمهم إلا الله﴾. A preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila [Translator's note: this refers to ﴿من بعدهم﴾].
﴿لا يعلمهم إلا الله﴾: لا is negative. يعلمهم: an imperfect verb and an advanced mafʿūl bihi. إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). The Name of Majesty: the delayed fāʿil. The clause ﴿لا يعلمهم إلا الله﴾: resumptive, with no grammatical position; or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿الذين﴾, or from the pronoun latent in the ṣila ﴿من بعدهم﴾; or the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of ﴿الذين﴾; it is also said that the clause is parenthetical between ﴿والذين من بعدهم﴾ and the clause ﴿جاءتهم رسلهم بالبينات﴾, which occurs as a ḥāl.
﴿جاءتهم رسلهم بالبينات﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position, or a second khabar of الذين; رسلهم is the fāʿil; ﴿بالبينات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جاءتهم﴾.
﴿فردوا أيديهم في أفواههم وقالوا إنا كفرنا بما أرسلتم به﴾: the فاء is a conjunction; ردوا is a verb and its fāʿil; أيديهم is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿في أفواههم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ردوا﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿وقالوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ردوا﴾; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause كفرنا is the khabar; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿كفرنا﴾; the clause أرسلتم is the ṣila; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أرسلتم﴾.
